plate.purpose: Runs column, empty runs placeholder, and default day arc ground; near-white with a faint warm tint in light, soft charcoal in dark.

paper.purpose: Window container background (containerBackground for .window; the window toolbar background is hidden so each column's ground shows through, never a solid toolbar), output column, empty detail, Settings, command well, menu bar popover.

ink.purpose: Primary and log text; next-run ring on the arc.

muted.purpose: Secondary text, timestamps, durations, arc labels.

hairline.purpose: 1pt separators and the command well border.

horizon.purpose: Arc horizon line and dotted full-day path.

sun.purpose: Succeeded glyph and title, passed marks, elapsed arc path, sun body, menu hover wash.

sunlight.purpose: Fixed in all appearances; translucent daylight fill and log selection only.

sky.purpose: Running glyph and title, running ring on the arc.

storm.purpose: Failed and interrupted glyphs, failure diamonds on the arc.

storm-text.purpose: Failure text: exit codes, Failed title, result values, errors.

dusk.purpose: Never-run glyph and the moon on the arc.

title.purpose: Run status in the output header and the app name in Settings; macOS title2, rounded semibold.

headline.purpose: Day arc title in the menu bar popover; rounded.

caption.purpose: Arc summary, arc hour labels (caption2), header field labels.

gradients.name: daylight
gradients.purpose: Day arc fill above the horizon, top of arc to horizon. The only gradient in the app.

motion.name: running-rays
motion.purpose: Running status glyph; disabled under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: arc-tick
motion.purpose: Day arc and relative times refresh each minute; durations of live runs each second.

toolbar.purpose: ContentView sets .containerBackground(Solar.paper, for: .window) and .toolbarBackgroundVisibility(.hidden, for: .windowToolbar). Never give the toolbar a solid background; it spans the whole window and flattens the floating sidebar.

accent.assetCatalog: AccentColor.colorset has no color, so selection and controls use the user's macOS system accent.
accent.selectedText: In emphasized selected rows (backgroundProminence .increased), text uses .primary/.secondary and status glyphs use .primary, rendering white on the accent.

components.name: Status Icon
components.description: Weather glyph per run state: sun passed, storm cloud failed, cloud interrupted, rotating rays running, horizon never run. In an emphasized selected row the glyph uses .primary: white on the system accent.
components.css: .ds-status-icons { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-status-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-rays { animation: ds-spin 2s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-rays { animation: none; } } .ds-status-icons.ds-selected { --ds-accent: #0A84FF; margin-top: 8px; padding: 4px 6px; width: max-content; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ds-accent); background: AccentColor; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-selected .ds-status-icon { color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Run Row
components.description: 40pt list row: glyph, name or time, detail line, trailing duration. Failure detail in storm-text. Selection is native in the user's system accent; when emphasized, text (.primary/.secondary) and glyph (.primary) turn white on the accent.
components.css: .ds-run-list { --ds-accent: #0A84FF; background: #FAF7F0; padding: 4px; width: 340px; } .ds-run-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #073642; font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: default; } .ds-run-row:hover { background: rgba(7,54,66,0.06); } .ds-run-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A84FF; outline: 2px solid AccentColor; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-run-row.ds-selected, .ds-run-row:active { background: var(--ds-accent); background: AccentColor; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-run-row.ds-selected .ds-run-detail, .ds-run-row.ds-selected .ds-run-dur, .ds-run-row:active .ds-run-detail, .ds-run-row:active .ds-run-dur { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-run-row.ds-selected .ds-run-icon, .ds-run-row:active .ds-run-icon { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-run-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-run-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; flex: 1; } .ds-run-detail { font-size: 11px; color: #4F646B; } .ds-run-detail.ds-fail { color: #B0201D; } .ds-run-row.ds-selected .ds-run-detail.ds-fail { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-run-dur { font-size: 11px; color: #4F646B; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Header
components.description: Output column header on plain paper: status glyph, status-tinted title, metadata, command. No wash; status reads through the icon and title only.
components.html:
Failed
Good Gratis Ingest · Oct 27, 2026 at 6:00:00 AM
mise ingest
DurationResult31sExit 1
components.css: .ds-status-header { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 16px 20px; background: #FFFDF8; border-bottom: 1px solid #E9E4D8; color: #073642; font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sh-icon svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; } .ds-sh-text { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-sh-title { font: 600 17px ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #B0201D; } .ds-sh-meta { color: #4F646B; } .ds-sh-cmd { margin-top: 8px; font: 12px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: #4F646B; } .ds-sh-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 2px 20px; text-align: right; } .ds-sh-grid span { font-size: 10px; color: #4F646B; } .ds-sh-grid b { font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fail { color: #B0201D; }

components.name: Command Well
components.description: Selectable monospaced command on paper with a hairline border, in the job summary.
components.css: .ds-command-well { background: #FFFDF8; border: 1px solid #E9E4D8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 12px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: #073642; user-select: text; width: 300px; } .ds-command-well:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A84FF; outline: 2px solid AccentColor; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Log View
components.description: Selectable, searchable monospaced log in ink on paper with sunlight selection.
components.html:
[ingest] $ rails runner Extract.call
Fetched 0 listings in 30.0s
Error: Net::ReadTimeout
exit status 1
components.css: .ds-log { margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; background: #FFFDF8; color: #073642; font: 12px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-log::selection { background: rgba(181,137,0,0.3); }

components.name: Menu Row
components.description: Menu bar popover row; sun at 18% with 6pt corners on hover.
components.css: .ds-menu { width: 320px; background: #FFFDF8; padding: 5px; } .ds-menu-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #073642; font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: default; } .ds-menu-row:hover { background: rgba(160,120,0,0.18); } .ds-menu-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A84FF; outline: 2px solid AccentColor; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-menu-time { margin-left: auto; color: #4F646B; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Settings Sidebar Button
components.description: Full-width Settings button pinned to the sidebar bottom; quinary on hover, quaternary when selected.

components.name: Day Arc
components.description: Signature: the sun's 24-hour path with daylight fill, elapsed path in sun, sun at now, status marks for today's runs, ink ring at next run.
components.html: 1 passed, 1 failed. Next run at 12:00 PM.
components.css: .ds-arc { background: #FAF7F0; padding: 8px 12px; width: 344px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-arc-summary { font-size: 10px; color: #4F646B; margin-bottom: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Sundial is a native Mac utility dressed as a day of weather. Healthy runs are sunshine, failures are storms, and the runs column opens on the sun's path across the day. The palette stays light and calm: near-white grounds with a faint warm tint in light, a soft neutral charcoal in dark. Solarized is the inspiration for that warm tint, the ink, and the accent hues (the sun's yellow carrying success, Solarized red carrying failure), not a source of literal beige or teal grounds.

Personality lives in color, weather glyphs, and the day arc; structure stays stock macOS. The window is a native three-column `NavigationSplitView` with system toolbars, segmented pickers, grouped forms, and a system-glass sidebar. Density is standard Mac list density. Status is never color-only: every state has its own glyph and a text label.

Every color token resolves four ways (light, dark, Increase Contrast light, Increase Contrast dark) through `Solar.color`. The frontmatter records the light value; the sidecar carries all four.
keyCharacteristics: Light, calm grounds: warm-white plate for the runs column, paper for the window, output, settings, and the menu bar popover; soft charcoal in dark.
Weather glyphs carry run state, each in its status tint.
The day arc is the signature, above the runs list and in the menu bar popover.
The accent is the user's system accent; the theme never recolors selection.
Native controls, navigation, and keyboard behavior throughout.

rules.name: The Weather Rule
rules.body: Run state maps to exactly one hue: sun for passed, sky for running, storm for failed and interrupted, dusk for never run. Nothing else borrows these hues for decoration.

rules.name: The Accent Is Not Status Rule
rules.body: The accent is the user's system accent: `AccentColor` is empty, so selection and controls follow System Settings. The theme never recolors selection, and run state colors (sun, sky, storm) never stand in for selection. Selected rows switch their text and status glyphs to the system's selected-text color.

rules.name: The Quiet Ground Rule
rules.body: Grounds stay near-white in light and neutral charcoal in dark. Solarized is the source of the warm tint and the accent hues, not literal beige or teal grounds.

rules.name: The Four Appearances Rule
rules.body: A new color is a `Solar.color` with light, dark, and both Increase Contrast values, never a single hex.

rules.name: The Rounded Headings Rule
rules.body: `.fontDesign(.rounded)` goes on status and identity headings only; body, rows, and logs stay in default SF Pro.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Plate holds lists; paper holds the window and content to read. A surface is one or the other, separated by a 1pt hairline, never a shadow, a tinted band, or a wash.

rules.name: The No Wash Rule
rules.body: Headers and bands sit on their column's ground. Status shows through the glyph and the status-tinted title, never through a tinted background.

dos: Do take every color from `Solar`, defined with light, dark, and Increase Contrast values.

Do leave `AccentColor` empty so selection and controls follow the user's system accent, and switch selected row text and glyphs to `.primary` / `.secondary` when `backgroundProminence` is `.increased`.
Do pair every status color with its weather glyph and a text label.
Do use storm-text, not storm, for failure text.
Do use native SwiftUI controls, lists, forms, toolbars, and split views; put personality in color, glyphs, and the day arc.
Do gate continuous motion on Reduce Motion, as the running rays do.
Do separate surfaces with 1pt hairlines in hairline.
donts: Don't give the app a custom accent or recolor selection; never use sun, sky, or storm to mark selection. Running is sky, the next run is ink.
Don't use green checks or red crosses for status; the weather glyphs are the status vocabulary.
Don't add shadows or card elevation; use the plate and paper grounds.
Don't apply the rounded design to body text, rows, or logs.
Don't add strong tinted bands or status washes behind headers.
Don't use literal Solarized beige or teal for grounds; keep them light and calm.
